messages:
mira: Heads-up — we need a tiny hotfix bump (v2.14.1 -> v2.14.2) for the metrics exporter NPE. Planning an expedited cutoff in ~2.5h. minimal-diff only, no behavioral changes.

sam: copying the stack trace from prod? any repro steps?

mira: repro is in the error group — null `metrics.labels` on rare path when model pool drains. patch is one-line null-check. PR coming in a min.

alex: pushing a WIP PR now: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/inference/pulls/8421 : adds `if (labels == null) return;` in exporter.

toni: @alex please ensure unit tests cover the null path, even if it's a tiny check — quick test ok.

alex: added a test and CI passed on the feature runner. also added a short changelog entry under patch notes.

chris: are we doing a canary? I'd like to smoke on dedicated first, then roll to hosted.

mira: yes — planned canary on dedicated-1 for 30m, then 10% traffic for hosted for 1hr. rollback plan is immediate deploy of last tag (v2.14.1).

jen: who is cutting the release branch and tagging? I can do it if folks are busy.

sam: I can cut the branch and tag in ~20m. Will ping when done.

alex: request reviews: @toni, @chris — small change but want the quick OK.

toni: on it, reviewing now. focus on minimal surface area. :eyes:

deploy-bot: CI status — PR 8421: checks passed (unit, integration-lite, lint).

toni: LGTM with one nit (inlined comment). Not blocking.

chris: Quick infra check — does this require any runtime flag?

alex: none. pure defensive null-check. No config or migration.

mira: ok squad: final checklist —
- sam to cut branch & tag
- alex merge after tag, then trigger canary deploy
- chris monitor dedicated canary, smoke tests: `/scripts/smoke_metrics.sh`
- jen hold the rollback steps (tag + deploy job) in case

sam: branch cut done: `release/2.14.2` created and tagged `v2.14.2` — sha: a1b2c3d 

alex: merging PR now and starting canary deploy to dedicated-1.

deploy-bot: Deploy started — v2.14.2 -> dedicated-1 (canary).

chris: smoke tests running, will paste results in 10m.

mira: reminder: do not ship any other unrelated commits. keep minimal-diff policy.

jen: rollback steps documented in runbook and I have the deploy command ready.

chris: smoke green on dedicated-1: metrics exporter no longer NPEing on the draining path. :white_check_mark:

alex: rolling to 10% hosted now.

deploy-bot: Canary passed — promoting to 10% hosted traffic.

mira: thanks everyone. post-deploy note: add an entry in the incident log with the root cause and the minimal fix, and a short test in release tests to avoid regressions.

sam: noted — will add changelog + release note and mark the ticket resolved.

mira: closing cutoff in ~30m, but we'll keep monitoring for 24h. ping me on pager if anything odd. :slightly_smiling_face:
